facts.fact: Al Manassa reports that on 27 October 2026 New Cairo Misdemeanor Court fined Mada Masr editor Lina Attalah EGP 3 million and ordered the news website closed, on charges of operating a website without a license.

The Egyptian Human Rights Forum report, via Al Manassa, says Al Manassa has been blocked 13 times, most recently in July 2022, and the Journalists Syndicate criticised the continued blocking in March 2024.
The Egyptian Human Rights Forum report describes Article 7 of the Anti-Cybercrime Law as letting the investigative authority order a website blocked, to be put to a court within 24 hours.

EGY.note: Report calls data protection inadequate; states no data protection law fact.
Names a rights forum's report but does not say it is a local research institution publishing on digital policy as defined; no fact recorded.
